patterns.component_extraction: Pages contain inline components (StatusBadge, ListItem, etc.) that should be extracted
patterns.file_structure: Main page file imports from newly created component files in components/[feature]/ directory
patterns.state_management: useState hooks for data, loading, error states; useCallback for data fetching
patterns.data_fetching: Supabase client created via createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client
patterns.modal_pattern: Modal state (isOpen, editing item, form data) managed at page level
patterns.form_pattern: Form state in local state object, handleSubmit function, error handling
patterns.list_pattern: Separate ListItem component with props for item data and callbacks

existing_implementations.description: Found component structure with ui/ directory for generic components and feature-specific subdirectories
existing_implementations.component_size_guideline: Existing components range 16-339 lines, most under 300 lines
